nodes.name: TODO Needs Twilio Credential - Redownload Media

parameters.content:
## Failed media retry (stub)
Calls the new claim_undownloaded_media(10, 5, 5) RPC (20260922210000_claim_undownloaded_media.sql, drafted alongside this build -- repo-only, not yet applied to the live project) -- the retry mechanism for the one gap the 2026-09-22 voice-memo/OCR-retry audit left open: reconcile_retryable_failed_inbound_messages requires storage_path is not null, so a failed *download* (twilio-webhook never even got the bytes) was invisible to every retry mechanism until now.

STOPS HERE ON PURPOSE -- this is the "stubbed but not fully built" half the master plan calls out explicitly (Stage 0 item 7): no Twilio credential exists anywhere in this project yet (nothing in local-agent/watcher ever called Twilio's API directly). Once provisioned (prefer a scoped Twilio API Key restricted to read-only Messages/Media access over the all-powerful main Auth Token), the missing half re-fetches media via Twilio's GET /Messages/{MessageSid}/Media.json using the claimed row's twilio_message_sid (twilio-webhook never persists the raw per-media MediaUrl, so this is the only way back to the bytes), re-uploads to the same bucket/key convention, and sets storage_path + status on success -- a repeat failure just leaves it failed with download_attempts already bumped by the claim above, no separate write needed.

Per the plan, this should probably share its actual re-fetch/upload logic with pipeline-twilio-reconciliation's auto-replay path once both are built for real -- both are fundamentally "re-run twilio-webhook's per-media processing outside the original request."

INACTIVE / BUILD-ONLY (n8n migration Stage 0). "Postgres (n8n pipeline)" is a placeholder credential -- see n8n/README.md.
